about.title: Amity Online BBA
about.description: Amity Online BBA is a UGC-approved undergraduate management program designed for 10+2 students aspiring to build careers in business management. The program delivers comprehensive business education with the flexibility of online learning. Students learn through live interactive sessions, recorded lectures, case studies, projects, and industry-relevant curriculum, building strong foundations in management principles, marketing, finance, HR, and operations.

ugc_deb.description: Approved by University Grants Commission – Distance Education Bureau. Degree is equivalent to a regular BBA.

aicte.description: Recognized by AICTE for management education.

aiu.description: Member of Association of Indian Universities.

specializations.name: General Management
specializations.description: Comprehensive business education covering all aspects of management including marketing, finance, HR, and operations.

specializations.name: Data Analytics
specializations.description: Specialized program focusing on business analytics, statistical analysis, data visualization, and business intelligence tools.

specializations.name: Travel And Tourism Management

faq.question: Is Amity Online BBA valid?
faq.answer: Yes, it is UGC-DEB approved and equivalent to a regular BBA degree.

faq.question: Can I pursue MBA after online BBA?
faq.answer: Yes, you can pursue MBA from any recognized university after completing online BBA.

faq.question: Are exams online?
faq.answer: Yes, exams are conducted online with remote proctoring.

faq.answer: No, the degree does not mention online or distance mode.

faq.question: Which specialization is best for me?
faq.answer: General Management is ideal for broad business knowledge, Data Analytics for tech-oriented careers, and Travel & Tourism for hospitality sector.

faq.answer: No, it's a continuous 5-year program with seamless transition from UG to PG.

faq.answer: Yes, you can choose any MBA/MCA specialization in the PG phase regardless of your UG focus.
